description: Add a Save contact button: visitors tap it and their phone offers to add the owner to its contacts (a vCard). One per page. Needs a phone number, email or website. The name defaults to the page's name, and the website to the page's own link (pass "" for none). Everything on it is public, so only add details the owner wants anyone to save. Change it later with update_block (title is the name).

address.description: A city or full address, on one line.

dialCode.description: Country code for the phone number, like "+44". Defaults to "+1".

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

name.description: The name on the card; defaults to the page's name.

phone.description: A phone number. Without a + it is taken as a US number unless dialCode is given.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

website.description: Defaults to the page's own link; "" for none.

name: add_contact_card
title: Add a contact card
